nodes.description: Blocked recipient address; transfers to it revert, and it is auto-initialized in transferFrom.
Mapping of token balances; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated by approve/approveAndCall, spent by transferFrom.
Total token supply set in the constructor; consumed by totalSupply().
Contract owner address; set to msg.sender in the constructor and checked by onlyOwner.
Pending owner used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string, set to PUG in the constructor.
Token name string, set to 'Pug Token' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public token transfer; blocks the newun address and debits/credits balances using SafeMath.
Public allowance-based transfer; initializes newun or enforces the newun block, then moves balances/allowances.
Sets an allowance and then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
onlyOwner function that sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender via address.transfer.
onlyOwner setter for the newun state variable.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
onlyOwner function that stages newOwner for the two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner, then zeroes newOwner.
Deploys metadata, mints the whole supply to owner and also registers owner in Owned.
Empty payable fallback/receive function of PugToken that accepts ether.
External spender callback interface invoked by approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner, owner check and ether recipient.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state mutation and before returning.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the entire contract balance to an externally controlled address.
Local address payable _owner = msg.sender inside clearCNDAO, used as the ether transfer recipient.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer(), subtracted from the sender balance.
Source address parameter of transferFrom(), debited without a direct owner check.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom(); also assigned to newun when it is address(0).
Amount parameter of transferFrom(), subtracted from balances[from] and the allowance.
Spender address parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Spender address parameter of approveAndCall(); also the target of the external call.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall().
Arbitrary bytes payload forwarded to receiveApproval.
New blocked-address parameter of transfernewun().
Candidate owner address parameter of transferOwnership().
Account queried by balanceOf().
Allowance owner queried by allowance().
Allowance spender queried by allowance().

edges.reason: tokens is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub before the recipient is credited.
msg.sender keys the balance entry that is debited in transfer and credited in transferFrom.
Recipient 'to' receives the credited token amount in transfer.
require(to != newun) gates the transfer path on the recipient address.
balances[from] is decremented by tokens with SafeMath.sub inside transferFrom, so 'from' controls the debited account.
tokens drives both the balance and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve/approveAndCall and read when spending in transferFrom.
spender indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
When newun == address(0), transferFrom assigns 'to' into the newun state variable.
spender indexes the allowance mapping in approveAndCall before the external call.
spender supplied by the caller becomes the callee of the external receiveApproval call.
Caller-controlled bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender and the granted tokens are passed into the external callback, letting the callee act on behalf of the caller.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
The callee of receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns true.
msg.sender is copied into _owner and is therefore the recipient of the whole contract balance.
Local _owner is the address used in address(this).balance transfer.
The onlyOwner setter writes the caller-supplied _newun into the newun state variable.
_newOwner is stored into the pending newOwner state variable.
msg.sender becomes owner in the constructor and must equal owner for onlyOwner access and acceptOwnership.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership and newOwner is later zeroed.
The onlyOwner modifier on transfernewun requires msg.sender == owner before newun can be changed.
tokenOwner is the lookup key into the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner is the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
totalSupply() computes _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]), an arithmetic read of the supply state.
balances[address(0)] is read inside totalSupply to adjust the returned supply.
clearCNDAO is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with owner before draining funds.
clearCNDAO unconditionally executes the full-balance ether transfer to _owner.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after mutating the allowance, enabling a reentrancy window.
The ether transfer can execute the recipient's payable code, which may re-enter the draining contract (limited to 2300 gas).
Constructor of Owned requires msg.sender to authorize owner initialization (owner = msg.sender).
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the entire _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the literal 10^30 total supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable to PUG.
Constructor initializes the name state variable to 'Pug Token'.
Constructor initializes decimals to 18.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner and writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner slot after the transfer.
transfernewun is the onlyOwner entry point that mutates the newun state variable.
tokens parameter is written into allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
tokens parameter is written into the allowance mapping in approveAndCall before the external call.

normalization_plan.reason: Local address _owner only exists to receive the drained balance inside clearCNDAO and has no standalone semantics.
Recipient parameter is meaningful only inside transfer's balance update and newun guard.
Amount parameter only describes the arithmetic applied by transfer to the sender/recipient balances.
Source address parameter is only used as the key of the balances/allowance mappings inside transferFrom.
Recipient parameter only drives the credit and the newun initialization inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter only drives the SafeMath subtraction of balance and allowance inside transferFrom.
Spender parameter only indexes the allowed mapping written by approve.
Token amount parameter is only the value stored by approve in the allowance mapping.
Spender parameter is both the allowance key and the target of the external call in approveAndCall.
Token amount parameter is only the allowance value set by approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes payload is only meaningful as the calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Setter argument is only the value written to the newun state variable under onlyOwner.
Candidate-owner argument only populates the pending newOwner state inside transferOwnership.
Lookup account parameter only keys the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
Owner parameter only keys the outer dimension of the allowed mapping read by allowance.
Spender parameter only keys the inner dimension of the allowed mapping read by allowance.
